name: Introduction and overview — F-117 Nighthawk — aircraft record
title: Introduction and overview — F-117 Nighthawk
description: Introduction and overview of the F-117 Nighthawk: What this aircraft is, its role, and why it matters in aviation history. The F-117 Nighthawk was the world's first operational stealth aircraft, built by Lockheed's Skunk Works and flying combat missions from 1983 (publicly revealed in 1988). Its faceted airframe deflected radar energy away from the source. 64 were built (59 production aircraft); they flew in Panama, Desert Storm, and Kosovo before retirement in 2008. Baseline facts: First operational stealth aircraft; 64 built by Lockheed Skunk Works; retired 2008..
how_it_works: Wings generate lift from airflow; the engine provides thrust; control surfaces and fly-by-wire or mechanical controls steer the aircraft in three axes.
